title: Health assessment.
bodyText: The department shall ensure the provision of a comprehensive health assessment for each child in out-of-home placement forty-five days before or after an initial placement.
bodyHtml: [§346-17.2]  Health assessment.  The department shall ensure the provision of a comprehensive health assessment for each child in out-of-home placement forty-five days before or after an initial placement. [L 2010, c 135, pt of §2]
